answer_1.quote: We contribute a novel data augmentation technique which creates enciphered copies of the source side of a parallel dataset. We then leverage this enciphered training data along with the original parallel data via multi-source training to improve neural machine translation (NMT) models.

answer_2.quote: We evaluate on BLEU scores 7 . Following previous work , we compute tokenized BLEU with multi_bleu.perl 8 for IWSLT14 and TED datasets, additionally apply compound-splitting for WMT14 En-De 9 and SacreBLEU 10 (Post, 2018) for IWSLT17 datasets.
